text:
maya (Design): Quick sync1: compact scrubber mock + "Sampled" badge copy. Proto: https://redwood.design/x/scrub-explain :link:

lee (Frontend): What's the priority? reduce visual noise or teach sampled vs exact?

maya (Design): Both but prioritize clarity. At medium widths p95 pill overlaps scrubber. Proposal: collapse to icon+abbr and show a short badge 'Sampled' with tooltip that explains ratio and a CTA to compute exact p95.

jon (Observability): Backend note: exact compute is async and costly. We should show estimated ETA and prevent spamming (rate limit). Also log p95 delta for telemetry.

rachel (A11y): Accessibility: avoid color-only cues. Add pattern overlay for high-contrast mode and an ARIA description for the badge. Tooltip text must be readable (4.5:1). Keyboard shortcut idea: press 'S' when scrubber focused to open the compute panel; announce job queued via aria-live.

lee (Frontend): Implementation plan: icon chip with aria-label="p95 120ms; sampled (1:10)"; click opens panel with ratio + "Compute exact p95" button. Use SVG patterns only when high-contrast to avoid perf hit.

maya (Design): Draft tooltip copy: "Estimated from sampled traces (1 in 10). Request exact computation (async)." Button: "Compute exact p95". Tone: neutral amber.

jon (Observability): +1. I'll add API spec and ETA behavior to the ticket.

rachel (A11y): I'll validate contrast and keyboard flow once prototype is in staging.

maya (Design): Thanks all — please drop prototypes/PRs in thread.
